# E3 云雨图与异常值诊断：云雨图 / 小提琴图 / 箱线图 + 固定 1.5×IQR 诊断
import io
import base64
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'],
    'axes.unicode_minus': False,
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 15,
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9.5,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9.5,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
})

PALETTE = ['#4F7FB3', '#DD6F75', '#956CB4', '#57A36B', '#DF9A3C', '#3E9CA6', '#B97855', '#7589A8', '#C07DA2', '#7E9B58', '#D8B24C', '#4E91C6']
GRID = '#D9DEE5'
TEXT = '#2D333B'
IQR_MULTIPLIER = 1.5
category_column = {{category_column}}
distribution_column = {{distribution_column}}
chart_type = {{chart_type}}
orientation = {{orientation}}


def _to_frame(value):
    if isinstance(value, pd.DataFrame):
        return value.copy()
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        for encoding in ('utf-8-sig', 'utf-8', 'gbk', 'gb18030'):
            try:
                return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.decode(encoding)))
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                continue
        raise RuntimeError('CSV 编码无法识别')
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.lstrip('\ufeff')))
    raise RuntimeError('输入 data 必须是 CSV 文本或 DataFrame')


def _safe_label(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return '缺失'
    return str(value)


def _style(ax, is_vertical):
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['left'].set_color('#59636E')
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_color('#59636E')
    ax.spines['left'].set_linewidth(0.9)
    ax.spines['bottom'].set_linewidth(0.9)
    ax.grid(axis='y' if is_vertical else 'x', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.65, color=GRID, alpha=0.78)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    ax.tick_params(colors='#46505A')


def _summary(series, original_index):
    clean = pd.to_numeric(series, errors='coerce').dropna()
    if clean.empty:
        raise RuntimeError('分布列没有可绘制的有效数值')
    q1 = float(clean.quantile(0.25))
    median = float(clean.quantile(0.5))
    q3 = float(clean.quantile(0.75))
    iqr = q3 - q1
    lower = q1 - IQR_MULTIPLIER * iqr
    upper = q3 + IQR_MULTIPLIER * iqr
    inlier = clean[(clean >= lower) & (clean <= upper)]
    whisker_min = float(inlier.min()) if len(inlier) else float(clean.min())
    whisker_max = float(inlier.max()) if len(inlier) else float(clean.max())
    numeric_all = pd.to_numeric(series, errors='coerce')
    mask = numeric_all.notna() & ((numeric_all < lower) | (numeric_all > upper))
    positions = np.flatnonzero(mask.to_numpy())
    row_labels = original_index[positions]
    return {
        'count': int(clean.size),
        'q1': q1,
        'median': median,
        'q3': q3,
        'iqr': float(iqr),
        'lower_bound': float(lower),
        'upper_bound': float(upper),
        'whisker_min': whisker_min,
        'whisker_max': whisker_max,
        'outlier_count': int(mask.sum()),
        'outlier_rate': float(mask.mean()) if len(mask) else 0.0,
        'outlier_rows': [int(i) if isinstance(i, (int, np.integer)) else str(i) for i in row_labels.tolist()],
        'outlier_values': [float(v) for v in numeric_all[mask].tolist()],
    }


def _violin(ax, values, position, color, vertical, half=False):
    if len(values) < 2 or np.unique(values).size < 2:
        return
    offset = 0.19 if half else 0.0
    center = position + offset
    parts = ax.violinplot(
        values,
        positions=[center],
        vert=vertical,
        widths=0.52 if half else 0.72,
        showmeans=False,
        showmedians=False,
        showextrema=False,
        points=160,
        bw_method=0.35,
    )
    for body in parts['bodies']:
        body.set_facecolor(color)
        body.set_edgecolor('none' if half else color)
        body.set_alpha(0.30 if half else 0.28)
        if half:
            vertices = body.get_paths()[0].vertices
            if vertical:
                vertices[:, 0] = np.maximum(vertices[:, 0], position + 0.09)
            else:
                vertices[:, 1] = np.maximum(vertices[:, 1], position + 0.09)
        else:
            body.set_linewidth(1.25)
            body.set_alpha(0.30)


def _scatter(ax, values, position, color, vertical, side=False, seed=0):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(20260904 + seed)
    jitter = rng.normal(0, 0.055 if side else 0.075, len(values))
    center = position - 0.20 if side else position
    categorical = center + np.clip(jitter, -0.15, 0.15)
    if vertical:
        ax.scatter(categorical, values, s=13, c=color, alpha=0.78, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.18, zorder=3)
    else:
        ax.scatter(values, categorical, s=13, c=color, alpha=0.78, edgecolors='white', linewidths=0.18, zorder=3)


def _box(ax, values, position, color, vertical, show_fliers):
    props = dict(linewidth=1.05, color='#3E464F')
    box = ax.boxplot(
        [values],
        positions=[position],
        vert=vertical,
        widths=0.13 if not show_fliers else 0.46,
        whis=IQR_MULTIPLIER,
        patch_artist=True,
        showfliers=show_fliers,
        boxprops=dict(facecolor=color, edgecolor='#3E464F', linewidth=1.05, alpha=0.68),
        medianprops=dict(color='#20262D', linewidth=1.5),
        whiskerprops=props,
        capprops=props,
        flierprops=dict(marker='o', markersize=4.0, markerfacecolor=color, markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.35, alpha=0.82),
        manage_ticks=False,
    )
    return box


if data is None:
    raise RuntimeError('请先连接并运行上游的数据导入插件')
if chart_type not in ('云雨图', '小提琴图', '箱线图'):
    raise RuntimeError('图形类型必须是云雨图、小提琴图或箱线图')
if orientation not in ('纵向', '横向'):
    raise RuntimeError('分布方向必须是纵向或横向')

df = _to_frame(data)
distribution_column = str(distribution_column or '').strip()
category_column = str(category_column or '').strip()
if not distribution_column:
    raise RuntimeError('请选择一个分布列')
if distribution_column not in df.columns:
    raise RuntimeError('找不到分布列：' + distribution_column)
if category_column and category_column not in df.columns:
    raise RuntimeError('找不到类别列：' + category_column)

numeric_values = pd.to_numeric(df[distribution_column], errors='coerce')
if numeric_values.notna().sum() == 0:
    raise RuntimeError('分布列必须包含可转换为数值的数据：' + distribution_column)

plot_df = pd.DataFrame({'__value__': numeric_values}, index=df.index)
if category_column:
    plot_df['__group__'] = df[category_column].map(_safe_label)
else:
    plot_df['__group__'] = '全部样本'
plot_df = plot_df.dropna(subset=['__value__'])
groups = list(dict.fromkeys(plot_df['__group__'].tolist()))
if not groups:
    raise RuntimeError('没有可绘制的有效数据')
if len(groups) > 12:
    raise RuntimeError('为保证科研图可读性，类别列最多支持 12 个类别')

is_vertical = orientation == '纵向'
label_length = max([len(str(group)) for group in groups] + [4])
if is_vertical:
    fig_width = min(16.0, max(6.6, 1.45 * len(groups) + 2.4))
    fig_height = 6.3 + min(1.2, max(0, label_length - 8) * 0.04)
else:
    fig_width = 9.2
    fig_height = min(15.0, max(5.2, 0.82 * len(groups) + 2.5))
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(fig_width, fig_height), facecolor='white')
positions = np.arange(1, len(groups) + 1, dtype=float)
by_category = {}
total_outliers = 0

for index, (position, group) in enumerate(zip(positions, groups)):
    group_data = plot_df.loc[plot_df['__group__'] == group, '__value__']
    values = group_data.to_numpy(dtype=float)
    color = PALETTE[index % len(PALETTE)]
    item = _summary(group_data, group_data.index.to_numpy())
    by_category[str(group)] = item
    total_outliers += item['outlier_count']

    if chart_type == '云雨图':
        _violin(ax, values, position, color, is_vertical, half=True)
        _box(ax, values, position, color, is_vertical, show_fliers=False)
        _scatter(ax, values, position, color, is_vertical, side=True, seed=index)
    elif chart_type == '小提琴图':
        _violin(ax, values, position, color, is_vertical, half=False)
        _scatter(ax, values, position, color, is_vertical, side=False, seed=index)
        median = item['median']
        if is_vertical:
            ax.plot([position - 0.22, position + 0.22], [median, median], color='#20262D', linewidth=2.0, zorder=5)
            ax.scatter([position], [median], s=38, facecolor='white', edgecolor='#20262D', linewidth=1.2, zorder=6)
        else:
            ax.plot([median, median], [position - 0.22, position + 0.22], color='#20262D', linewidth=2.0, zorder=5)
            ax.scatter([median], [position], s=38, facecolor='white', edgecolor='#20262D', linewidth=1.2, zorder=6)
    else:
        _box(ax, values, position, color, is_vertical, show_fliers=True)

if is_vertical:
    ax.set_xticks(positions)
    ax.set_xticklabels(groups, rotation=25 if label_length > 10 else 0, ha='right' if label_length > 10 else 'center')
    ax.set_xlabel(category_column if category_column else '')
    ax.set_ylabel(distribution_column)
    ax.set_xlim(0.35, len(groups) + 0.65)
else:
    ax.set_yticks(positions)
    ax.set_yticklabels(groups)
    ax.set_ylabel(category_column if category_column else '')
    ax.set_xlabel(distribution_column)
    ax.set_ylim(0.35, len(groups) + 0.65)
    ax.invert_yaxis()

_style(ax, is_vertical)
category_note = category_column if category_column else '未选择类别列（全部样本）'
ax.set_title(chart_type + '与异常值诊断', loc='left', fontweight='bold', color=TEXT, pad=12)
fig.text(0.075, 0.025, '异常值诊断固定采用 1.5×IQR；云雨图中的箱体不重复绘制离群点，散点保留全部观测。', fontsize=8.5, color='#66707A')
fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.12 if is_vertical else 0.18, right=0.97, top=0.90, bottom=0.17 if is_vertical else 0.13)
_buffer = io.BytesIO()
fig.savefig(_buffer, format='png', dpi=300, facecolor='white', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
image = 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(_buffer.getvalue()).decode('ascii')
report = {
    'method': 'IQR',
    'iqr_multiplier': IQR_MULTIPLIER,
    'chart_type': chart_type,
    'orientation': orientation,
    'category_column': category_column or None,
    'distribution_column': distribution_column,
    'categories': groups,
    'total_outliers': int(total_outliers),
    'by_category': by_category,
    'note': '云雨图的箱线层隐藏离群点标记，雨点层保留全部观测值。' if chart_type == '云雨图' else None,
}
return {'image': image, 'report': report, 'data': data}
